papers.title_en: Machine learning-based diagnostic decision support for suspected anterior cruciate ligament tears in clinically evaluated athletes
papers.authors: Fatma Mrad, Khaled Trabelsi, Asma Aloui, Rihab Al Abaidia, Achraf Ammar, Haitham Jahrami, Nafaa Souissi
papers.evidence: 监督机器学习分类器辅助运动员前交叉韧带撕裂诊断
papers.tldr: 急性前交叉韧带撕裂（ACLT）在初次就诊时常因症状限制检查、诊断工具可及性不足而难以识别。本研究利用196名疑似ACLT运动员的7项常规二分类临床变量，构建8种监督机器学习分类器，并在独立留出集上评估。Optuna调优的XGBoost取得最高ROC-AUC 0.962与F1 94.25%，SHAP显示关节积液贡献最大。结果提示仅凭初诊临床变量即可为首次评估提供决策支持，但临床应用前仍需前瞻性外部验证。
papers.abstract_en: Anterior cruciate ligament tears (ACLT) may be difficult to identify at the initial clinical encounter because acute symptoms can limit examination and access to diagnostic tools may be constrained. This study evaluated supervised machine-learning models for ACLT decision support using routinely available initial clinical data. Data from 196 athletes with suspected ACLT (146 confirmed ACLT; 50 symptomatic non-ACLT) were represented by seven manually annotated binary clinical predictors. Participants were stratified into training (n = 137) and independent held-out evaluation (n = 59) sets. Eight classifiers were optimized using nested cross-validation within the training set and evaluated using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and receiver operating characteristic area under the curve (ROC-AUC). Classification used a training-derived F1-optimal threshold of 0.50. Optuna-tuned XGBoost achieved the highest ROC-AUC (0.962) and F1-score (94.25%); XGBoost, support vector machine, and k-nearest neighbors achieved the highest recall (93.18%). SHAP analysis of XGBoost identified joint effusion as the strongest contributor to model output. These findings indicate that supervised machine-learning models based exclusively on initial clinical variables may support ACLT assessment at first presentation. Prospective external validation is required before clinical implementation.

papers.title_en: Sex-Equitable Machine Learning Prediction of Ankle Reinjury in Individuals with Chronic Ankle Instability: A 2-Year Prospective Cohort Study with Fairness Audit
papers.authors: Ui‐jae Hwang, Seong Jun Son, Siu-Ngor Fu, Arnold Yu Lok Wong, Dustin A. Bruening, Brent Feland, Martha Seeley, J. Ty Hopkins
papers.evidence: 机器学习模型预测两年踝关节再损伤并进行公平性审计
papers.tldr: 慢性踝关节不稳患者两年再伤率近50%，但缺乏个体化预测且未审查性别公平性。研究基于100人两年前瞻队列，用六种算法和嵌套交叉验证构建再伤预测模型，并以Shapley值解释关键预后因素。弹性网模型AUC达0.807，性别、足弓高度、既往扭伤、背屈活动度和稳定性指数最重要。采用性别特异阈值后均衡赔率差距降低57%，但差异影响比仍未达标，需外部验证。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Patients with chronic ankle instability (CAI) face a 2-year reinjury rate approaching 50%, but individualized prediction models that quantify which baseline impairments predict subsequent reinjury within an established CAI cohort remain scarce, and existing prediction models for ankle injury have not assessed sex-related fairness. The aim was to develop and internally validate sex-equitable machine learning (ML) models predicting 2-year ankle reinjury in individuals with CAI, identify the most influential baseline prognostic markers, and audit sex-stratified model performance. METHODS: One hundred physically active individuals (50 male, 50 female) with CAI (mean age 21.8 ± 2.3 years) were recruited from a university population between February 2017 and February 2018 and prospectively followed for 2 years; 96 (49 male, 47 female) with at least one follow-up response were retained for analysis (41 reinjury events, 43% reinjury rate). Fourteen baseline predictors spanning demographic, anthropometric, injury-history, patient-reported, biomechanical, postural-control, and functional-performance domains were collected. Six algorithms were trained with nested cross-validation: an unpenalized logistic regression baseline and five ML algorithms (Elastic Net, support vector machine, random forest, XGBoost, LightGBM). Predictive contribution of each feature was quantified using Shapley additive explanations and partial-dependence plots. A pre-specified fairness audit compared single global and sex-specific Youden thresholds derived out-of-fold using the equalized-odds gap and disproportionate-impact ratio. RESULTS: All algorithms achieved area under the curve (AUC) values above 0.70; Elastic Net was selected as the primary model (AUC = 0.807, 95% CI 0.714-0.893; calibration slope = 1.015). Sex, arch height index, previous sprains, dorsiflexion range of motion, and Biodex Overall Stability Index consistently emerged as the most influential prognostic markers. Within-sex discrimination was comparable between males and females, but a single global threshold produced an equalized-odds gap of 0.384 that was reduced by 57% (to 0.164) through sex-specific thresholding without retraining the model. CONCLUSIONS: ML models with a fairness-audited threshold strategy predicted 2-year ankle reinjury in individuals with CAI, reducing the equalized-odds gap by 57%, though the disproportionate-impact ratio (0.683) remained below the 0.80 benchmark. External validation is required before clinical deployment.

papers.title_en: Clustering professional football players using Gaussian mixture models: A case study of the English Premier League 2024/25
papers.evidence: 用高斯混合模型对足球表现数据聚类以识别球员类型
papers.tldr: 针对足球球员角色常被硬聚类归为单一类型、难以刻画混合角色的问题，研究基于2024/25英超314名非门将球员的表现数据，对主成分表示应用高斯混合模型（GMM）进行概率聚类。全样本识别出7种球员原型，后验成员概率揭示跨簇混合角色与战术灵活性，并在后卫、中场、前锋内部恢复位置特异子原型和异常值。该框架以概率成员量化归属不确定性，为招募与战术决策提供可解释工具，并可迁移至其他运动领域。
papers.abstract_en:
The increasing availability of detailed football performance data has created new opportunities for identifying player archetypes and informing recruitment and tactical decision-making. Most existing clustering approaches assign each player to a single group, despite the reality that many modern footballers perform hybrid roles spanning multiple stylistic categories. Performance data for 314 outfield players from the 2024/25 English Premier League season are analysed using a Gaussian mixture model (GMM) applied to principal component representations of player statistics. Unlike hard-assignment methods such as k-means, the GMM provides probabilistic cluster memberships, allowing uncertainty and role hybridity to be quantified. Seven player archetypes are identified in the full dataset. Posterior membership probabilities reveal a subset of players whose profiles span multiple clusters, providing an objective measure of tactical flexibility and stylistic ambiguity. Further analyses within defender, midfielder, and forward groups recover position-specific sub-archetypes and highlight exceptional outliers. The results demonstrate that model-based clustering provides a flexible and interpretable framework for identifying latent structure in high-dimensional performance data while explicitly quantifying uncertainty in cluster membership. More broadly, the approach is readily transferable to other sports and domains in which individuals exhibit overlapping characteristics and cannot be adequately represented by hard cluster assignments alone.

papers.title_en: Wearable Sensor‐Based Prediction of Knee Joint Moments in Competitive Rugby Players During Multidirectional Movements
papers.authors: Zixiang Gao, Robin Trama, David Mcnish, Michael Esposito, Jake Ruschkowski, Darren John Stefanyshyn, John William Wannop
papers.evidence: 可穿戴足底压力传感器结合可解释机器学习预测膝关节力矩
papers.tldr: 橄榄球多方向动作中膝力矩难以在场外连续监测。研究用足底压力传感器与GA-DFR在31名竞技橄榄球运动员中筛选7–18个传感器，并以嵌套交叉验证预测膝合力矩及三个分量。合力矩汇总R²为0.795，屈伸、内收外展、内外旋R²分别为0.806、0.662、0.675，性能优于线性回归和CNN。SHAP显示关键贡献集中于支撑期9%–55%，为无标记可解释膝负荷评估提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT This study aimed to develop an interpretable machine learning framework using plantar‐pressure sensors to estimate knee moments during rugby‐specific movements. A total of 31 North American competitive rugby players were recruited to perform four common rugby movements on an infilled artificial turf surface in a motion capture laboratory. Synchronized data acquisition was performed for plantar pressure, motion capture, and ground reaction forces. Knee moments were calculated via inverse dynamics. Genetic Algorithm‐Deep Forest Regression (GA‐DFR) was used to select plantar‐pressure sensors and predict resultant moments within participant‐level nested cross‐validation. Four alternative models predicted the resultant using the same layouts and participant splits. Complementary deep forest regression (DFR) models predicted the three moment components using these layouts. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) interpreted held‐out predictions. Layouts contained 7–18 sensors. Pooled resultant R 2 was 0.795, with root mean square error of 0.0512 N·m/N. DFR performed better than linear regression and the convolutional neural network, with no significant differences from the deep neural network or long short‐term memory network. Pooled R 2 was 0.806, 0.662, and 0.675 for flexion‐extension, adduction‐abduction, and internal‐external rotation moments, respectively. Resultant temporal SHAP contributions exceeded their stance‐wide mean during 9%–55% of stance, peaking at 24%. Reduced plantar‐pressure inputs supported estimation of resultant and direction‐specific knee‐moment waveforms in unseen rugby players.

papers.title_en: Throwing4: phase-aware pose modeling for throw-distance prediction in elite athletics
papers.authors: Bikash Kumar Badatya, Kartike Tiwari, Jyotirmoy Amin, Ravi Hegde
papers.evidence: 阶段感知姿态建模预测投掷距离，属运动表现评估的人工智能方法
papers.tldr: 投掷项目（铅球、铁饼、标枪、链球）的远度预测长期依赖人工标注与整体动作特征，难以刻画出手前后各阶段的姿态差异。Throwing4 提出阶段感知的姿态建模框架，将投掷动作按技术阶段切分，分别提取骨骼序列特征并融合为远度预测。在精英运动员数据上，模型预测精度优于整体动作基线，且各阶段贡献可解释。该工作为田径投掷项目的技术诊断与训练反馈提供了可量化工具。
